description: The rankings of a game for one (neblla.scores; boards declared with neblla_update_app({ scores })). action "remove": take a user's score off a board { board, player } (a cheat that got in). Refused scores never enter: they are in the app log (neblla_get_logs, area score). An ELO board ({ type: "elo", start: 1200, k: 32 }) moves with the results of matches (neblla_matches); action "setRating" { board, player, rating } sets where a player starts (their level known elsewhere), and the matches after count from it. The actions that only look (top, player) are in neblla_scores_read.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

player.description: The user id in the app

rating.description: setRating: the rating they start from

name: neblla_scores
title: Scores
